spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Broken, divided.
2 Refuted.
E.
वि before खण्डित the same.

m. (-रः)
A goblin, a demon, a Rākṣasa.
E.
वि before खुर to cut, aff. क.

mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं)
Noseless.
E.
वि privative prefix, and ख्य substituted for नस or नासिका; also other as arbitrary terms, or विख, विग्र, विग्र, &c.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Known, notorious, famous.
2 Avowed, confessed.
E.
वि before ख्या to say or tell, aff. क्त.

f. (-तिः)
Fame, celebrity, notoriety.
E.
वि before ख्या to say or tell, aff. क्तिन्.

n. (-नं)
1 Confessing, acknowledging, avowing, declaring.
2 Explaining, expounding.
E.
वि before ख्या to say, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-ख्रुः-ख्रुः-ख्रु)
Noseless; also विख and विखु.
